claim: पश्चिम, वायव्य और नैऋत्य दिशा की ओर जमीन का उतार होने पर वह भूमि परिवार के लिए निष्प्रयोजन व्ययकारी होने से अर्थ संकट को प्रदान करती है।
description: If the land slopes down toward the west, north-west (वायव्य) or south-west (नैऋत्य), it causes wasteful expenditure and financial difficulty. | Avoid such slopes; correct with fill/leveling if already present.
remedy: Level land so downward slope faces east/north-east/north rather than west/south-west/north-west.

remedy: Fill any central depression before building.

If the flowers sink and do not float, the land is inferior and inauspicious. | Use the floating-flower method as a quick evening land-quality test.
remedy: Do not build any structure on land where the flowers sink.

description: At dusk, enclose a patch of ground with matting to block airflow, inscribe the astra-mantra 'ॐ हूं फट्' on the ground, place an unbaked clay pot and an unbaked clay lamp filled with ghee on it, with four wicks (white-east, red-south, yellow-west, black-north), consecrate the wicks with the Namokar Mahamantra, and light them. If the wicks burn until the ghee is exhausted, the land is auspicious; if they extinguish before the ghee is exhausted, the land is inauspicious and troublesome. | Perform this mantra-lamp ritual as a land-quality test prior to construction. | Mantra / spiritual practice (from source): The Namokar Mahamantra ('ॐ णमो अरिहंताणं, णमो सिद्धाणं, णमो आइरियाणं, णमो उवज्झायाणं, णमो लोए सव्व साहूणं...') followed by 'ह्रौं शांति कुरु कुरु स्वाहा।'
remedy: The Namokar Mahamantra ('ॐ णमो अरिहंताणं, णमो सिद्धाणं, णमो आइरियाणं, णमो उवज्झायाणं, णमो लोए सव्व साहूणं...') followed by 'ह्रौं शांति कुरु कुरु स्वाहा।'

claim: ईशान - पुरुष वंश की निरंतरता को सुनिश्चित करता है। मकान में इस दिशा को काट देने से पुत्र नहीं होते।
description: North-east ensures continuity of the male lineage. Cutting off / obstructing this direction in the house results in the family not having sons. | Keep the north-east corner of the plot uncut and unobstructed to support continuity of the male lineage.
remedy: Avoid cutting the north-east corner of a plot/building.

source.original_text: ईशान - पुरुष वंश की निरंतरता को सुनिश्चित करता है। मकान में इस दिशा को काट देने से पुत्र नहीं होते।

claim: ऐसे भूखण्ड जिनमें उत्तर एवं पूर्व में सड़क हैं, उनमें ईशान में पाकशाला (रसोई घर) बनाने से पारिवारिक कलह तथा धन हानि का संताप भोगना पड़ता है।
description: For plots with roads on the north and east sides, placing the kitchen (पाकशाला) in the north-east (Ishan) causes household discord and financial loss. | Avoid placing the kitchen in the Ishan (north-east) corner, especially on plots with north- and east-facing roads.
remedy: Relocate the kitchen away from the Ishan corner.

source.original_text: ऐसे भूखण्ड जिनमें उत्तर एवं पूर्व में सड़क हैं, उनमें ईशान में पाकशाला (रसोई घर) बनाने से पारिवारिक कलह तथा धन हानि का संताप भोगना पड़ता है।

claim: मसलन वास्तु की ईशान दिशा की दीवाल कमजोर हो गई हो अथवा ईशान दिशा में शौचालय या रसोईघर हो। ईशान दिशा में सबसे ऊंचा भाग हो या ईशान दिशा का भाग कटा हो तो वास्तु बिकने के प्रसंग आ जाते हैं। यदि उपरोक्त वास्तु दोषों को सुधार लिया जाए तो परेशानियों से मुक्ति मिल जाती है।
description: Financial and family difficulties leading owners to sell their homes can be traced to Vastu faults such as: a weakened wall in the north-east, a toilet or kitchen located in the north-east, the north-east portion being the highest part of the building, or the north-east corner being cut off. | Check and correct any of these Ishan-corner faults if a household is experiencing financial or family trouble.
remedy: Correct these specific Ishan-corner faults (strengthen the wall, relocate the toilet/kitchen away from Ishan, lower the height of the Ishan portion, restore any cut corner) to relieve the associated difficulties.

claim: घर के मध्य भाग में स्तम्भ हो या घर के मध्य भाग में अग्नि या जल का स्थान हो तो घर में स्तम्भ वेध या हृदय शल्य होता है। इससे वंशनाश, कुल क्षय की संभावना रहती है।
description: Occurs when there is a pillar at the centre of the house, or when a fire installation or water body/tank is located at the centre of the house — also called 'hriday shalya' (heart-thorn defect). | Keep the exact centre of the house (Brahmasthan) free of pillars, fire installations, and water bodies.
remedy: Remove or relocate any pillar, fire source, or water feature from the exact centre of the house.

claim: राजमार्गान्तरे वेधो न प्राकारन्तरेऽपि च। स्तंभ पदादि वेधस्तु नाभित्यंतरतो भवेत्।। देवालय और मकान के मध्य यदि राजमार्ग, कोट, किला आदि आयें तो वेध दोष नहीं होता।
description: If a public road, boundary wall, or fort/rampart lies between a temple and a house, no Vedh defect arises. If there is a wall in between, the pillar-base Vedh defect is also nullified. | When an obstruction (e.g., temple, pillar) faces the main door but a road or wall genuinely intervenes between the two, the Vedh defect is considered neutralised.
remedy: Ensure a road, boundary wall or rampart genuinely separates the house from the obstructing structure to neutralise the defect.

claim: उच्छ्रायभूमि द्विगुणां त्यक्त्वा चैत्ये चतुर्गुणाम्। वेधादि दोषो नैवं स्याद् एवं त्वष्टमतं यथा।। (आचार दिनकर)
description: If the distance to the obstruction is at least twice the height of the house (or four times the height in the case of a temple), any Vedh-type defect is not counted as applicable. | When evaluating whether an obstruction constitutes a Vedh defect, first check whether it lies beyond twice the house's height (or four times a temple's height) — if so, no defect applies.
remedy: Increase the distance between the building and the obstruction to at least the prescribed multiple of height, where feasible.

claim: इन्द्राणी व प्रतिष्ठाचार्य स्नानादिक से निवृत्त हो शुद्ध वस्त्र (धोती-दुपट्टा) पहनें, मन्दिर में इर्यापथ शुद्धि करके भगवान के दर्शन करें...
description: The Indra/Indrani and the presiding ritual-acharya bathe and wear clean garments (dhoti-dupatta), perform irya-path-shuddhi (purification of movement) at the temple and pay respects to the Jina image. The Jina idol is carried to the ritual site, placed on a decorated pedestal/vedi; sacred designs (mandala) are drawn; Indra-Indrani sakalikaran, Indra pratishtha, and mandap-shuddhi are performed; then a panchamrit abhishek (five-nectar consecratory bath) is offered before all present worship the Deva-Shastra-Guru trinity, offer arghya, and begin the main ritual, ending with a visarjan (closing) and homa (fire offering). | Follow this sequence for a formal Vastu Vidhan ritual: purification bath and clean dress → irya-path-shuddhi and darshan → mandala drawing → sakalikaran/pratishtha/mandap-shuddhi → panchamrit abhishek → Deva-Shastra-Guru puja and arghya → main vidhan → visarjan and homa. | Mantra / spiritual practice (from source): The overall Vastu Vidhan ritual sequence itself (sakalikaran, panchamrit abhishek, Deva-Shastra-Guru puja, arghya, homa).
remedy: The overall Vastu Vidhan ritual sequence itself (sakalikaran, panchamrit abhishek, Deva-Shastra-Guru puja, arghya, homa).
